title: PyroWave 4:4:4 Haar — Quest Pro (experimental)
notice: Experimental GPU Haar 4:4:4. Desktop bitrate: 400 Mbit/s (editable below). Headset: PyroWave, 90 Hz, 8-bit, resolution/stream scales 1.0, foveation 0%. Measured 85–88 fresh frames/s on 5 GHz; sustained 90 Hz and Wi-Fi 6E remain unqualified. Save and reconnect to apply.
notes: Matching client/server required. GPU compute decoding; preserves full chroma.
Quest Pro OpenXR recommendation 1440x1584 per eye; encoded padding 1472x1600.
Keeps existing host application, tracking, hostname and service port.

expected_target_mbps.assumption: Equal eye dimensions and alpha at half eye height; aggregate target, not measured bandwidth.
